Fieldwork

Fieldwork, for me, starts with place. Whether developing public sculptures in cities or pursuing long-term conceptual projects, I’m driven to understand where I’m working.

This page collects the ways I do that through travel and residencies, research on site, drawing and rendering, and custom built tools like LineWorks, which turns what a place sounds like into form. Together they shape my vocabulary and my view of the world.

I share day-to-day process material on Instagram.
